paite: Huan Setan in Israelte asual a, David bel Israelte phakzah sim utna aneisak hi.
heading: David In Kisimna Abawl / (2 Sam 24.1-25)
english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

paite: Huan David in Joab leh amiliante uh kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan tan in Israel mite sim unla, aphakzah uh ka theihtheihna ding in hong hilh nawn un," achi hi.
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

paite: Joab in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite amun za in hihpung taleh zong, kumpipa ka toupa, ka toupa mite mah hilou uh ahi maw? Bangziak a ka toupa'n huai theih kilawp ahia? Bangziak a Israelte siam louh tanlohna hi ding ahia oi?" achi hi.
english: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

paite: Huchi in Joab apawtkhia a, Israel gam tengteng ah apai a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

paite: Joab in mihing om zah David ahilh hi. Israel gam a namsau tawimi tengteng maktaduaikhat-le-nuaikhat ahi uh; huan Judah gam a namsau tawimi bel nuaili-le-singsagih ahi uh.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

paite: Levite leh Benjaminte bel asimtel kei; Joab in kumpipa thupiak zakdah lamtak ahi ngal a.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

paite: Huai thil ah Pathian akipak kei a; huchi in Israelte agawtta hi.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

paite: Huchi in David in Pathian kiang ah, "Hiai thil ka na hihna ah nakpitak in ka na hihkhialta ahi; himahleh na sikha thulimlouhna hehpih in ngaidam in, haihuaitak in ka na hihta hi,” achi hi.
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N zawlnei Gad kiang ah,
english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, David kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Thil thum ka hon tah: na tung a ka hih ding in alak ua khat tel in achi,' " va chi in.
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

paite: Huchi in David kiang ah Gad ava hoh a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:

paite: Akoi ahia na deih tel in; kum thum kialpi tun hia, na melmate namsau a delhphak a om a kha thum na melmate vuallelhsak hia, ni thum hipi len ding, TOUPA namsau a TOUPA angel in Israel gam tengteng a mi ahihmanthat zel?' chi in. Huchi in kei hon sawlpa bang ka chi dawn dia, kingaihtuah inla, hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

paite: David in Gad kiang ah, "Ka lungzing mahmah, TOUPA khut ah puklut peuhmah mai leng; azahngaihna lah athupi mahmah ngal a; mihing khut ah zaw hon puklutsak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hipi alengsakta.
english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua hihse ding in Pathian in angel asawl a; ahihsiat dek laitak in, TOUPA'N a-en a, thil hoih lou hih atup akhiam a, mite hihmangthang angel kiang ah, "Ahunta; na khut lik nawn ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA angel Jebus mi Ornan phual chin ah adingh hi.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

paite: David adaktou a, TOUPA angel, namsau phawisa a Jerusalem lam ngim a, lei leh van kikal a dingh amu hi. Huchi in David leh a-upate'n sai-ip puan silh in lei ah abokkhup uhi.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

paite: David in Pathian kiang ah, "Keimah ka hi kei a hia mipite sim ding chih thu pepa? Keimah ka hi ginat huai loutak a thil na hihkhial, hiai belamte'n bang thil ahia ahih tei uh? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, keimah leh ka inkote tung ah na khutkha inla, na mite'n hipi thuak nawn kei uhen," achi hi.
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel in David kiang a Gad va hohtou a, Jebus mi Ornan phual a TOUPA dia maitam doh ding a David hilh ding in thu apia hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

paite: Gad in TOUPA min a athugen ziak in David ahohtouta hi.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.

paite: Ornan akilehhei a, angel amu a; atapa li akiang a omte abuta uhi. Ornan in buh ana chil ahi.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

paite: David, Ornan kiang atun in, Ornan akihei a, David amuta a, huan phual a kipan apawtkhia a, amai a lei si in David ma ah abokkhup hi.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

paite: Huchi in David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hiai phual TOUPA a dia maitam ka bawlna ding in hon pe dih ve; aman kim geih la in hon pia in, mipite lak a hii akikhin theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

paite: Ornan in David kiang ah, "Tang in, TOUPA ka kumpipa'n pha asak bang in hih hen; halmang a lat ding in bawngtalte, sing ding in phual vanzatte, tangbuang thillat ding in buhte ka hon pia hi; ka hon sutuah vek ding," achi hi.
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

paite: Huan kumpipa David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hilou e; aman kim geih in ka lei zaw ding, man bei in TOUPA a ding in nang a ka la kei ding, halmang thillat leng ka lan kei ding,” achi a.
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

paite: Huchi in David in huai mun leina in Ornan dangka-eng shekel zaguk apia hi.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

paite: David in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam abawl a, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan a, TOUPA asam a; TOUPA'N maitam tung ah mei in van a kipan in adawngta hi.
english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N angel thu apia a, anamsau apai ah athun nawnta hi.
english: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

paite: Huchi in David in Jebus mi Ornan phual ah TOUPA'N ahon dawng chih atheih in huai ah akithoihta hi.
english: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

paite: Huai lai in Mosi in gamdai a TOUPA biakbuk leh halmang thillatna maitam abawl Gibeon khua mun sang ah a-om ahi.
english: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

paite: Himahleh David bel TOUPA angel namsau akihtak ziak in Pathian dong ding in huai ah ahoh thei kei hi.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.
